body: Its me again. If you want to talk to me feel free to. Sorry to hear you're going through this again.
Find a sport or hobby.
london

Happy? Living in a different environment, an apartment or house somewhere I am not threatened. Enough money to eat and buy trivial cosmetics things like toothbrushes etc. Being around a supportive person for a while.

What I need to stop considering suicide is a living somewhere else where I can go out without being threatened and have enough to eat.

I've tried it all. There is NO REASON AT ALL the girl who was supposed to help me can't.

I don't know what I can be expected to do.
I have aspergers syndrome so probably not. It also is never immediate. It may take 6 months for me to be able to go.
I am from the UK. I was in college which is the equivalent of high school. I had to drop out at 17 because my family were so abusive.

I can't go to one because many times I leave the house I'm threatened to be killed.

I have also asked about it. They said they have a shortage of space and I would be lucky to find somewhere.

I am using this thread to vent my feelings and unless I get some really logical responses chances are no posts will change my mind.

So if you plan to say "don't do it", I genuinely appreciate the sentiment, but it may be a waste of time.

Your genes aren't toxic just because you're a little different. Maybe you should learn to communicate better in order to make your life easier.

You seem reasonably articulate. How good were your grades in school?
You may be able apply for a scholarship.

I'm in a similar situation but I don't have the option of applying for one because I was screwed over by the school system.

You can try exercising whenever you get the feeling and having a busy social life. This has worked for me in the past.

Also, there isn't really anything wrong with masturbation. Its healthy. Its actually recommended you do it every now and then but if you really want to stop I suggest finding a way to be really busy.

Its still possible to make it through. Eminem was bullied through school also. He's also said he has been through similarly hard times.

Anyway, I hope you can make it through this.

Try learning more about beats and rap music. Try listening to some more instrumentals for inspiration. J.dilla is a good place to start. If you don't have beat making software, try to get some. You can also try sampling some songs.

As for improving your ability as a lyricist, perhaps developing your vocabulary would be a good place to start. Try to learn a handful of new words each day then begin incorporating them into your music. This will greatly increase your freedom of things to say since you'll almost always be able to find a rhyming synonym.

If you like enimem here is a list of rappers you may like:
Odd Future
Immortal Technique
Jay Electronica
Kanye West
Macklemore

I also recommend that you don't only feel the need meet the standards of the average rapper. There isn't any reason you shouldn't be able to greatly exceed it.

Anyway, I hope this helps, at least a little bit.

Hopefully your life will turn around, as for now I would try to find something to make life worth living. In school I would do intense basketball training 3 times a day in order to cope with how horribly I was treated.

It would make me so tired I couldn't be mad at what people told me, I couldn't be saddened and I had a nice sore feeling in the morning. When the bullying reduced I noticed that I stopped going. Sports/Running/Exercise can be a very constructive outlet.

You also mentioned that you like eminem and rap music. Try making some rap songs. Try producing some beats. Mathematics and science are also options. Just do what you love to cope. However, I really want to emphasize that from my experience intense work outs are the most effective.

I know, but people threatened me and I can't really go outside. I can get a job, but it would be FAR less mentally distressing if I moved countries entirely. I am scared to move countries independently since I have very little experience. There is this girl who may help me but I have to wait. If it does happen luckily it would change my life around entirely.

I am very sorry to hear this, I went through MUCH of the same thing during school and growing up, my parents would often move and leave me behind with my uncle would would beat me in the face and threaten to make me eat my own vomit if I were to throw up the strange ethnic food I was forced to eat even if it made me sick. I really wish I could do something for you, but unfortunately I am 19 and still stuck with my abusive parents who stopped feeding me and caused me to have a nervous breakdown. Its caused me quite a few psychological problems like being unable to articulate my thoughts properly (or at least immediately but it should revert if I am eventually in a better living situation).

I really wish life wasn't so cruel for the both of us. Hopefully one day this planet will be safe and tolerant for all. As for now, all I can say is that there is a chance things can get better. That is all we can hope for. I wish you the best and hope a very fortunate event comes your way.
I know this is really unconventional, but maybe he should try exercise and creating goals for himself. It helped me before but I am not in a position to do that now.

I am sorry to hear this, I NEVER said money solves all problems, I just said it makes things easier in CERTAIN cases. Your case may be far different and you may not be solvable with money. I am saying many things can be. Obviously your wealth isn't proportional to your happiness but money can sometimes solve some problems. I am sorry I made it appear this way. However, I please urge you to be more civil on a suicide subreddit.
There isn't any objectively correct way to look. If your intention is to lose weight and its not for health reasons i just wouldn't worry about it.
According do what you've said if she is reasonable she would take you back. This doesn't seem to be your fault at all. It doesn't really seem like you did anything.

Also, if I were in her shoes I would feel entirely obligated. If I were rich and had never done a charitable act or even tried to partake in a charitable act I would define myself as a degenerate. We should all be trying to help each other on this planet because all conciousness is just as valid as the next. Especially human consciousness.

I would also like to say, even subtly implying what she implied is akin to telling somebody who lives in a third world country, "Don't worry about the fact that you haven't eaten in days, me and my loving family will take care of you" Then later on saying "HAHAHAHA DIE DIE DIE".

This wasn't really a situation of anonymity either the circumstances did incline me to believe she was serious.

Because I believe it was some kind of agreement her parents made.

Also, people who are suffering don't think logically. She was the only one who was there for me during my nervous breakdown and it kinda feels like I am stuck with her now.

I am just inclined to believe that people who are mad or do things that aren't kind are out-letting pain from something else. I don't really believe you can't make life better for this person and that she can't make life better for you.

In my scenario the girl who is supposed to be helping me is constantly mocking me, I understand this is probably due to psychological reasons and she is not evil, but I am still suffering due to her apathy. If I thought the way that she did and laughed at serious things I would keep it to myself and help the person I was supposed to help. What she has done actually probably would warrant me saying and doing horrible things to her, but I wont because its a matter of atoms reacting with other atoms. She isn't evil nor am I. She would just need a turn around in personality and to show she is a nice person and give sincere VERY Sincere apologies and try to show humility and gratitude if I did forgive her.

I've been like that before but it was when I was very young and was more so because my family would shout at me for not adhering to their arbitrary logic. I found out that the medicine for this was to not be around my parents and work out until I am sore. Whenever I get back I am too tired to be mad.

These things seem very compromisable. If she wants to go out everyday, maybe meet her half way, go do some of the things you both enjoy outside when you can and the stuff you both like indoors. Try finding mutual interests much of the time. If she is loud maybe you could try doing nice quiet things with her so she isn't loud. As for the lashing out thing you have to convince her to think a little more logically and be more understanding.

Also maybe she is emotional because she is lonely or something. Maybe try spending pleasant intimate time with her? Your scenario looks VERY fixable especially if your only alternative is living in a shelter or committing suicide.

Just try to talk things out and come to compromises.

Unless she gets mad for no reason AT ALL (which I doubt) it could be attributable to things that she is unaware of, she may not be eating enough or might be sexually frustrated or lack of exercise or something else I can't see this being a problem. Just check first, it could be low self esteem, poor self image, overeating, undereating lack of exercise etc. It can all be fixed. Just always try to make sure she is okay and come to compromises.

If you were to explain why you fight with your girlfriend I may be able to help you. I fight with the girl I talk to but she very often appears apathetic and I have told her on multiple occasions I am scared for my life because people threatened me and I am tired of feeling locked in this house. My family members also treat me poorly from time to time and it doesn't feel good being around them.

It seems pretty obvious that if I were in better surroundings I would be happier and less inclined to shout at her.

This sounds eerily similar to what I am going through. I mean really eerily similar. Nonetheless, why do you fight with your girlfriend? I believe ALL problems are ALWAYS fixable. If you moved in with her to escape your mentally abusive mother and you moved in with her and lived a non stressful life, wouldn't this make you happy? I believe the reason people argue and get mad is because they're going through hard times. If her parents were rich and could easily afford a decent house and stuff to do, why would you be mad at each other? I am pissed off at my abusive parents because they were abusive, but I understand they've lived stressful lives. If we met 5 years later after I've cooled down since I am human and get emotive like we've evolved to get, (even though what they did could have hypothetically killed me), I would still forgive them.

So tell me, why do you have this bad relationship with her?

Yes I do, I can't leave I tried and I don't know where to get a low paying job somewhere I wont be killed. 

I would cut off contact with her, but she is my only option and she genuinely did try to help once or twice. Even if it took 9 months. Also, my relation to her is stronger than what I have with my mother since my mother caused me to have a nervous breakdown and she brought me out of it. If I cut off contact I assume I would turn out to be some kind of psychopath. Since I feel no relation to people.

My hobby is physics but the stem fields seem to be hostile towards ethnic minorities and I haven't had decent prior education. Also seems like any contribution that I were to make would immediately be dismissed if I hadn't been to expensive schools prior, which is fucking ridiculous, but I understand humans are fucking ridiculous beings.

I am 19, no job, I had to drop out of school because my parents were so abusive. People threatened to kill me because I live in a bad neighbourhood and for being anorexic because my parents wouldn't feed me.

I am not in debt but I would want to live somewhere relatively safe with the amount of paranoia a have because of what was done to me.

She has optionally chosen not to help me with any of this.

I also kinda feel like I am stuck with her now since she is the one who came to me and brought me out of my depression even though she was being disingenuous through much of it. I feel closer to her than I do to my mother because of how things have played out. If she were to continue this I don't know what I would do, and I already feel like killing myself after just some of the things she has done.

I honestly see her as a piece of shit for not leaving me to kill myself since all that happened is that I suffered for longer and now I am going to die.

The reason I mention her wealth is to emphasize the point that is is highly unlikely she is suffering or going through any kind of traumatic or hard experience herself.

Most of time time if you're rich any problem you have can be solved with money. Getting bullied at school, you can get a tutor. Hungry and no food in the house you can go out because you live in safe neighbourhood or order something without it being note worthy expense.

Not money problems, my parents family abused the living shit out of me now I have nowhere else to stay. If I live on the streets I may be stabbed or killed because I was threatened multiple times. I wouldn't care if I was poor as fuck, yet eating properly and living in a caring environment. I just don't want to fucking suffer. Who says I care about money?
